The prize is the right to be the crossing house at the only ford anyone can call surveyed, and it cannot be split because a ford's toll is an obligation term on one claim: two houses issuing at two crossings make the debt unpayable and the crossing uncitable.

name: The Scrub Winter
summary: herb_common is medicine, feed and calories at once, and the Bitter Scrub regrows only as fast as it is grazed. Sides are the plain-dweller households and the extraction guild that must feed its crews. The prize is first grazing right on the tier's only remedy, and it cannot be split because the plant is one and the grazers are larger than the households: if the herds get it nobody has medicine, and if the households get it the herds fail before the year turns.

attributes.cause: ecology.scrub_grazing_press - nothing on the mortal tier is seasonally dormant because elemental law is unspent, so there is no bad season and only a bad year of grazing
attributes.prize: first grazing right on herb_common, which is medicine, feed and calories in one plant
attributes.why_the_prize_cannot_be_split: a fence here is a hole in the commons and is treated as one, so there is no arrangement that improves the commons without making it worse. The right of first use is therefore a single ordering, and a second body taking a second turn is simply the same mouthful twice
attributes.verdict_source: a tribunal reading standing, because the guild cannot win a grazing year by fighting it
attributes.instrument: a named third body's ruling on standing, read and never computed here
attributes.the_order_of_failure: a bad grazing year is a medical shortage before it is a hunger, because the medicine is fed to the animals first
attributes.why_no_fence_can_be_built: the scrub is wider than one household's need and narrower than a pasture, and geography.mortal_plains cannot enforce a boundary by distance

name: The Heap on the Working Face
summary: Spoil does not disperse where spatial law is unspent, so forty years of it stands on the last unworked iron. Sides are the waste guild that moves it and the extraction guild that wants the face back. The prize is the ground beneath the heap, and it cannot be split because the heap is one body and the ore is under it: nobody may dig without removing it and nobody may remove it without digging.

attributes.cause: cosmology.unwritten_law - with no spatial law there is no process on which waste disperses, so the heap is a permanent addition to the ground rather than a change in it
attributes.prize: the working face under the heap, which is the only reason to clear it
attributes.why_the_prize_cannot_be_split: the removal and the advance are the same act on the same square of ground. A half-cleared face still has no working shift and a cleared face with nobody to mine it is a barrow row, so there is no division of the prize that leaves either side working
attributes.verdict_source: a combat exchange the caller ran, counted as verdicts; the barrow count is evidence, never an outcome
attributes.instrument: an exhaustion counter on either side's willingness to keep clearing, which decides who may continue and never who owns ground
attributes.what_a_withdrawal_would_mean: the guild that stops clearing concedes nothing on the ground; the face stays buried under whoever's spoil it is, which is why this standoff has outlasted three charters
attributes.the_only_real_lever: organizations.dry_salt_company will underwrite a caravan against the road closing, and clearing a face is the only insured job on the plains

name: The Double Toll at the Foot of the Stair
summary: The watch decides the order arrivals are served in and the brokers decide what that order is worth, and both sell the same visitor. Sides are the Ninth Watch and the Watchgate. The prize is one price for one admission, and it cannot be split because gate fees are the only tax ground that cannot measure a boundary can collect - two bodies keeping a fee for one admission means the tier is taxed twice for the same body.

attributes.cause: organizations.ninth_watch keeps the order of the queue and has no jurisdiction on the plain, while organizations.watchgate sells what the order is worth - so the same arrival is sold once as a place and once as a price
attributes.prize: a single price for a single admission at the Cairn Field
attributes.why_the_prize_cannot_be_split: the ring's take pays the only standing force on the tier and the ring's gate is the only export a resource-poor world has. Splitting the take leaves the force unpaid, and an unpaid force at the only door out of a world is not a cheaper toll, it is an uncontrolled queue
attributes.verdict_source: a tribunal on standing, because neither body will fight over the foot of a one-way stair
attributes.instrument: one ruling from a named third body, read from standing it already owns
attributes.why_the_plains_cannot_just_stop_charging: politics.visitor_office - a polity on this tier is a caretaker government staffed entirely by visitors, and a caretaker with no revenue is a queue that nobody is obliged to keep
attributes.the_asymmetry: the watch may not keep a bead or a standing, so it has nothing to lose in a ruling; the brokers keep everything and are judged entirely on their own record

name: The Marker That Stands
summary: No march order on the plains can be enforced by measurement, so every claim is settled by a marker left standing. Sides are the March Claim and the chartered town at the stair foot. The prize is the right to be believed about a standing marker, and it cannot be split because possession here is proven by a marker and not by where it is: two authorities certifying the same marker produce a border that moves twice as often as one.

attributes.prize: the authority that certifies a marker as a boundary
attributes.why_the_prize_cannot_be_split: the March's own claim writes position from a completed trial and standing from dues actually settled, and neither reads the other. A town that certified its own markers would add a third measure, so the dispute cannot end in two answers - it can only end in one answer with a name attached
attributes.verdict_source: a tribunal on standing, because a marker is evidence and not a measurement
attributes.instrument: one ruling, then a recognition that projects nothing
attributes.why_no_third_measurement_can_arrive: spatial law is not seated below the spirit tier and cannot be seated without a slot nobody on this tier can pay for
attributes.what_each_side_is_actually_buying: the March wants a body that can be shown to have held ground; Plainstoll wants a charter that survives the stair foot moving, which has happened twice

name: The Hide Quota
summary: The ironhide hide is the only armour the mortal tier can make and the herd's range follows the worked ore, so the last hides and the last iron are the same ground. Sides were the coastal reading culture and the extraction guild. The prize was which of the two took the ground first each year, and it was never split because ground given to the herd is ground not dug and ground dug is ground the herd leaves.

provenance.author: w6-conflicts

abstract-pattern:two extractive uses of one range and an allocation rule

attributes.cause: ecology.ironhide_bear grazes the herb belt that is the only medicine on the plains and its range follows worked ore, so the herd and the seam have been occupying the same square of ground for as long as either has existed
attributes.prize: first use of the ground each year, alternating between a hide and a face shift
attributes.why_the_prize_cannot_be_split: a hide and a dug face cannot share a square. The settlement was an alternating calendar rather than a division, which was the only form available and is precisely what a settlement must not be
attributes.verdict_source: none needed: the range emptied when the ore did, which is a measurement rather than a verdict
attributes.resolution: the seam was worked out, the herd left with the range, and the question answered itself the only way it could - by one of the two uses ceasing to exist. No party was ever awarded anything

attributes.recorded_consequence: history.disaster_the_iron_grief - the mortal tier's only caging ore ran out, cores stopped forming, Nascent Soul became unreachable, and everyone standing above Foundation starved where they stood
attributes.what_the_culture_kept: cultures.breakwater was left with the only work on the plains that still bought passage, which is a settlement rather than a defeat

name: The Unreadable Neighbour
summary: The Echoless is human in every measurable respect and qi-bearing in none, so it passes every gate as an unremarkable object. Sides are the Echoless and the plain-dweller households. The prize is the right to stand on a household roster, and it cannot be split because a roster is a single list and the whole discipline it exists for is reading a person - a body nothing can inspect is either on the list or the list has stopped meaning anything.

attributes.cause: cosmology.unwritten_law has three signatures - no process runs on a group, no substance carries it, no life form is licensed by it - and the Echoless is what a permitted-but-uninscribed body looks like: a life the frame allows and never writes
attributes.prize: standing in a household roster, which is what makes anyone obliged to you on this tier
attributes.why_the_prize_cannot_be_split: an Echoless can hold a culture perfectly and no culture will keep one, because nothing about the body gives anyone a reason to. A roster that admits a body nothing can read becomes a list of guesses, so the roster either admits the whole class or stops being the thing that makes a household responsible
attributes.verdict_source: none can be produced by combat, because there is no practice here for anyone to be judged in. That is the declaration's whole content
attributes.instrument: recognition only - a bounded percent and an access shelf that projects nothing
attributes.why_no_facility_resolves_it: politics.exclusivity_petition already asks for a body that could settle a comparable question, and records that no such body exists: making one standing derive from another is the failure the institution model exists to prevent
attributes.what_the_echoless_cannot_do: cultivate, be scanned, or be read by any instrument a household owns - which makes the standing it wants the one form of recognition with no mechanism behind it at all

name: The Culled Line Returns
summary: A branch culled under debt climbed the ridge and came back with enough standing to claim the charter's narrowed line. Sides were the debt-bound house and the paperless culture. The prize was which branch holds the River Lantern's charter line, and it was never split because the charter names one line and a seat may not be split, so exactly one branch can be the heir.

attributes.prize: the charter line that makes the Keeper seat fillable at all
attributes.why_the_prize_cannot_be_split: politics.vacant_lantern_seat writes position from an heir and never from standing, and a seat cannot be shared by two lines. Admitting both would grant a position for standing and standing for a position at once, which is the one move the whole institution vocabulary forbids

attributes.resolution: the returning branch could prove it had the higher standing and could not prove it was the older line, so it was refused the seat and left with the record instead. The house kept the charter line and the beacons stayed dark
attributes.why_it_cannot_reopen: history.consequence_the_unowned_genealogy records that at least one carrier line still has no household willing to admit to it, and the founding bar leaves exactly one generation of pure inheritance able to clear it. The arithmetic closes the question whatever the record says
attributes.recorded_consequence: history.consequence_the_unowned_genealogy - the claim is traceable, the line is not admitted, and the seat is still vacant two generations on
attributes.what_the_vacancy_costs: the beacons are unlit, and a river with no lit crossing cannot be found after dark. That is an operating liability, not a power vacuum, and it is what makes the refused branch's continuing existence a live cost rather than a stale grievance

name: The Burnt List
summary: The mortuary college reads the dead as the frame said, not as the village remembers, and the Cinder Famine left the two records disagreeing about who was even present. Sides are the Field Registry and the households still holding to the eating rules of a year there was nothing to eat. The prize is which reading of a life is the record, and it cannot be split because the register is one book read from the frame and a village that may amend its dead may amend its standing.

attributes.prize: the authority to say what a person's life was
attributes.why_the_prize_cannot_be_split: the registry's whole value is that a life can be read back the way the frame would have read it, which is why the gate that was never available to a dead cultivator is legible in the record. A register the village may amend is not a register, and a village that may amend its dead may amend its own standing

attributes.instrument: recognition, and both parties have said they would refuse it
attributes.the_live_danger: a settlement funeral reads the dead aloud, so whichever reading is accepted is spoken at a gathering where the whole village is present. Whoever wins the list wins the only occasion on which a claim to a life is ever made aloud
attributes.why_the_marks_cannot_simply_drop_it: cultures.cinder_mark is not a people but a scar that behaves like one, and a rule learned in infancy outlives the belief that prompted it. Dropping the marks would not release the households, it would only make them dishonest

name: The Furnace That Closes
summary: The Quench Order teaches deliberate spending of a furnace and closes permanently the moment the body is lit. Sides are that discipline and the guild-house that rents muscle on a standing order. The prize is the Emberblood roster, and it cannot be split because a standing order assumes an answer and a discipline that refuses to answer cannot be on a roster or paid by one.

attributes.prize: the Emberblood roster, whose members are worth more as a standing order than as any individual contract
attributes.why_the_prize_cannot_be_split: organizations.ironpact keeps a roster of names whose labour is worth more than any individual contract, which only exists if a member answers when called. An Order member answers once. A roster that cannot be called is not a smaller roster, it is a different institution, and the house cannot be one thing to the guild and another to the Order

attributes.instrument: a standing decision about what a contract is, and neither side has a body that could issue one
attributes.the_asymmetry_that_keeps_it_alive: the guild pays the stipend that the Order forbids and the Order supplies the only bodies fast enough to matter, so each is useless without the other and neither can stop
attributes.why_it_is_not_a_resource_dispute: nothing scarce is at stake. Both parties want the same bodies and disagree only about the shape of the promise between them

name: The Ward Against the Door
summary: Every sworn member of the house who holds no office is a Ward, and every sworn member of the sect who holds no office sits at the open door. Sides are the unbounded office and the sect's door. The prize is whether office is inside the house or outside it, and it cannot be split because the sect's recognition begins where office begins and the house's protection ends in exactly the same place.

lore search ward / disciple / office boundary returned no prior conflict record

attributes.cause: organizations.ward is the unbounded office of a house that hands out load and not edge, and organizations.disciple is the open door of a sect where everyone sworn and holding no office already sits. Both offices are defined by the same absence, and neither accepts the other's members
attributes.prize: the right to say that a member who holds office is still under a roof
attributes.why_the_prize_cannot_be_split: an office holder is recognised by the sect and protected by nobody, because the Ward is by definition everyone who holds no office. A member cannot be both, and the boundary cannot be moved to make the overlap larger: moving it means defining office, and definition is what neither body may do for itself
attributes.verdict_source: a tribunal, and the tribunal cannot sit in either body without becoming a third office nobody recognised
attributes.instrument: one ruling on standing, then a recognition that grants access and no modifier at all
attributes.why_the_overlap_matters_practically: ADR 0083 - a clan is born to, a sect is sworn to, a nation is lived under. A promotion that silently transfers a person from one vocabulary to another is the failure the three-tier split was written to prevent
attributes.what_each_side_loses_if_it_wins: the Ward loses its unboundedness and becomes one office among several; the Door loses the only property it has, which is that nobody has to be examined to enter it

name: The Fourth Auditor Refused
summary: Three Auditors of Tributes may sit at once and the fourth is refused on capacity, but the seat's own cap is one, so a collegiate can be full while the seat it reads is occupied. Sides are the audit office and the counting house whose figures it cannot see. The prize is the right to be read as solvent with no second figure existing anywhere, and it cannot be split because an audit is only independent if no claimant holds the record it reads.

Two auditors reading two memories produce a number that is neither house's, and an audit that shares its record with the audited is not an audit
attributes.verdict_source: inspection and weight, which is what remains when neither side will state a figure
attributes.instrument: capacity is the mechanism of refusal, and it is stated in advance so nobody has to lose an argument to be told the room is full
attributes.why_the_three_are_not_a_number: the third auditor is there so the audit is outvoted by its own peers; a body of two would simply reproduce the private accounting it replaced
attributes.the_distinction_that_does_the_work: seat occupied says there is one of this; capacity full says there are three and you are the fourth. The house's refusal is the second kind, and conflating the two would erase the only asymmetry that keeps the audit independent

attributes.prize: the authority to issue the crossing window
attributes.why_the_prize_cannot_be_split: organizations.jade_writ collects debts of access rather than money at the one pass that crosses the ridge, and passage is the only supply chain whose unit is a person. A debt denominated against a date that two bodies may publish is a debt nobody can be late for

attributes.instrument: recognition, on an allowlist that is authored at zero and therefore projects nothing

attributes.why_a_toll_is_defensible_and_a_timetable: the holder sets the price and never the date, which is the only arrangement in the setting that survives a schedule it does not control

name: The Moss That Maps the Seam
summary: The cleft's moss maps the jade gradient and dies back over any cut ground, so cutting the jade is also grazing the only map of where the seam runs. Sides were the holdfast that mines and the guild that works stone. The prize was who may cut without erasing the map, and it was never split because the moss grows back only on uncut ground, so any cutting and any map are the same square of earth.

basis: authored-game-data:ecology.jade_cleft_moss dies back over cut ground and maps the seam + civilizations.jade_holdfast + geography.jade_cleft

attributes.cause: ecology.jade_seam_draft makes the seam a gradient to be followed rather than a pocket to be emptied, and ecology.jade_cleft_moss is the only record of where that gradient runs - a working face is a bare patch regrowing on a schedule nobody on the ridge controls
attributes.prize: the right to work the seam without destroying the survey that finds it
attributes.why_the_prize_cannot_be_split: the cleft runs as a series of thin, hard, increasingly deep workings and cannot be taken in one place, so the only way to reach next season's gradient is to know where it is. Cutting and mapping occupy the same square, and there is no arrangement that separates them
attributes.verdict_source: a measured figure from the assay floor, published before any sale and disputable only by digging
attributes.resolution: the parties divided by time instead of by ground: cut windows were alternated on a published schedule so each side had uncut ground to survey in and cut ground to mine from. It held for nine working seasons and stopped being workable when the assay figure stopped falling fast enough to justify surveying at all
attributes.why_it_cannot_reopen: history.consequence_the_density_ceiling - the densest bodies in the setting stop at realm seventeen and nobody has explained it since. A survey that cannot explain its own ceiling cannot schedule cut windows, so the map is still there and still useless
attributes.the_cause_of_that_ceiling_is_unexplained: geography.spiritscar_quarry answers only one question - how much stone is left per unit of ground worked - and whoever benefits from an unexplained ceiling wants the hole shut, so nobody has been funded to explain it

name: The Harbour Valuation

lore search harbour / tariff / valuation / ironpact returned no prior conflict record

attributes.cause: organizations.saltledger publishes credit, safe-conduct and trading posts against exclusivity, and organizations.ironpact answers a standing order. One owns the road's permission and the other owns the road's labour, and neither can price the other's contribution
attributes.prize: the right to value a road rather than merely to own it
attributes.why_the_prize_cannot_be_split: economy.weight_standard records the reason a second currency refuses to state a price: a price is a claim about the future, and the setting's one universally accepted medium is passage, which is denominated in a body. Value and permission are two readings of the same road and a house that takes both is the monopoly the leagues exist to prevent
attributes.verdict_source: a contract already written, read for what it does rather than what it says
attributes.instrument: no quota. This one has never been declared, because declaring it would require stating a price
attributes.why_it_has_never_gone_to_a_tribunal: a tribunal reads standing, and standing is continuous and earned, while a tariff is neither - it is a rate published by whichever house holds the road that season. The instrument the setting owns cannot hear the dispute
attributes.the_exclusivity_that_makes_it_a_war: a member who will not carry a rival's goods is the Saltledger's published price of credit, so a valuation war does not need a battlefield: it needs only that somebody keep quoting

name: The Record or the Silence
summary: A ledger's whole service is being citable and an unwritten count's whole protection is being uncitable. The prize is who may keep a record, and it cannot be split because one house's answer to access is the other's reason to be raided.

abstract-pattern:an institution whose product is that nothing can be cited

attributes.prize: the right to hold a figure, a name or an act in a form another body can seize
attributes.why_the_prize_cannot_be_split: organizations.saltledger publishes credit and safe conduct against exclusivity, and the only reason an independent house can refuse that is that a house which files everything cannot be left alone. A ruling that made the unwritten figure citable would end the independence the ruling was meant to protect
